description: Sign-in, MFA, privileged access, and identity governance for about 45,000 workforce users and federation for 46,000 external PDPP users

manual_workaround: Sealed break-glass accounts per critical system; cached credentials on field tablets for offline daily logs
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Used by every process below; the enclave uses a separate government-community identity tenant federated for administrators only

business_process: Group cloud platform, WAN, and jobsite connectivity
description: Landing zone on provider A, DR on provider B, WAN to 220 offices, and cellular and fiber links to about 1,350 jobsites
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: PDPP integration services, the digital twin service, and the AI estimating connector run behind the hub; jobsites lose drawings and safety forms without connectivity
manual_workaround: Cellular failover at every jobsite trailer; direct SaaS access bypassing the hub for the project management SaaS
dependent_third_parties: Cloud providers A and B; carriers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: PDPP, A&E digital twin, Property tenant portal integrations, TSSI remote access platform

description: 24x7 SOC, SIEM, EDR, email security, and incident handling for all divisions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The DFARS 252.204-7012(c) 72-hour clock and Form 8-K Item 1.05 timing keep running during an outage; payment fraud is detected by mailbox and sign-in alerts
manual_workaround: Retainer firm's tooling; EDR console reachable from provider B
dependent_third_parties: SIEM and EDR vendors; forensic retainer
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Every notice clock in P08 depends on SOC facts

business_process: Payment factory: disbursements and vendor master
description: Subcontractor and supplier payments (about $900 million a month), vendor bank-change verification, positive pay, and bank file transfer
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Federal prime contractors must pay subcontractors within 7 days of receiving Government payment (FAR 52.232-27(c)(1)); missed payroll-adjacent runs cause liens and stop work; a corrupted vendor master is a fraud channel
manual_workaround: Bank portal manual release of a pre-approved payment file with dual approval; no vendor changes accepted during downtime
dependent_people_or_facilities: Treasury and AP operations; payment verification team
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Construction (all subcontractor payments); A&E (subconsultants). Property AP runs separately on SYS-D3 (gap 3)

description: Current drawings, RFIs, submittals, and change documents in the PDPP for about 1,350 projects
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Building to superseded drawings causes rework and safety exposure (structural and life-safety revisions); field crews start at 6 a.m.
manual_workaround: Daily offline sync of current drawing sets to field tablets; printed sets in each trailer
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: A&E issues design revisions through the PDPP on design-build work; Property approves tenant improvement submittals in it. CUI drawings belong only in SYS-G6 (gap 1)

description: Pre-task plans, permits, inspections, incident reporting, and the safety computer vision alerts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Work stops without permits and inspections; serious injury reports to OSHA have fixed deadlines (29 CFR 1904.39) regardless of system state
manual_workaround: Paper permit books and safety forms in every trailer; phone reporting to the safety director
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Uses SYS-G1 sign-in and jobsite connectivity (BP-G03)

description: Heating, cooling, ventilation, and life-safety interfaces at 64 properties
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Tenants cannot occupy buildings without HVAC in summer heat; life-safety interfaces (smoke control, elevator recall) must stay under local control
manual_workaround: Local controller operation and on-site engineers at each property; BAS front ends are not required for local control
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: No group SOC monitoring today (gap 4); integrators' remote access bypasses group PAM

business_process: Access control and video at owned properties
description: Badge access, visitor management, and video for tenants and 9 federally leased properties
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Federal tenants' security requirements and tenant leases require controlled access; doors fail secure or open per fire code
manual_workaround: Security officers at entrances; local controller badge cache
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: TSSI unit installed systems at 12 properties under intercompany work orders; Section 889 screening gap for Property procurement (gap 5)

description: Monthly pay applications with schedules of values, lien waivers, and owner approvals (about 2,100 a month, $1.18 billion billed)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash flow and owner payment terms are monthly; a delay of more than 3 days in pay week delays receipts by a month on some owners; remittance instructions are a BEC target
